title: Housing Wealth and Consumption: The Role of Heterogeneous Credit Constraints
title_zh: 住房财富与消费：异质性信贷约束的作用
authors: S. Borağan Aruoba, Ronel Elul, Şebnem Kalemli‐Özcan
abstract: ABSTRACT We quantify the role of heterogeneity in households' financial constraints in explaining the link between the decline in aggregate consumption and the decline in house values between 2006 and 2009 using individual‐level data. Constraints that are triggered by a decline in house values, and a small fraction of consumers facing particularly severe constraints prior to the decline in house values explain 76% of the aggregate response. Local general equilibrium feedback and a decline in bank credit to consumers make up the remaining 24%. We find no contribution of a pure wealth effect in explaining the consumption decline.
abstract_zh: 我们利用个体层面数据，量化了家庭金融约束异质性在解释2006年至2009年间总消费下降与房屋价值下降之间关联中的作用。由房屋价值下降触发的约束，以及在房屋价值下降前已面临特别严重约束的一小部分消费者，解释了总消费反应的76%。局部一般均衡反馈和银行对消费者信贷的下降构成了剩余的24%。我们发现，纯财富效应在解释消费下降中并无贡献。

title: Optimal monetary policy with confounding information
title_zh: 混淆信息下的最优货币政策
authors: Qiushuo Ding, Yulei Luo, Gaowang Wang
abstract: In this paper, we study optimal monetary policy in an economy where firms’ price-setting decisions are distorted by a signal-extraction problem: they cannot perfectly distinguish aggregate from idiosyncratic shocks based on noisy local information. This systematic misattribution of aggregate shocks to firm-specific factors generates an additional price response, implying that strict price stability is no longer optimal. Instead, the optimal policy fully stabilizes the output gap, which necessarily requires accommodating fluctuations in the price level. The cyclicality of the optimal price level depends on the source of firms’ incomplete information: learning from local demand signals implies a procyclical price level, whereas learning from local productivity signals yields a countercyclical one.
abstract_zh: 本文研究企业在价格设定决策中因信号提取问题而扭曲的经济环境下的最优货币政策：企业无法基于含噪的局部信息完美区分总体冲击与异质性冲击。这种将总体冲击系统性误归因于企业特定因素的现象，会引发额外的价格反应，意味着严格的价格稳定不再是最优选择。相反，最优政策应完全稳定产出缺口，这必然要求容忍价格水平的波动。最优价格水平的周期性取决于企业不完全信息的来源：从局部需求信号中学习会导致价格水平呈顺周期性，而从局部生产率信号中学习则会产生逆周期性。

title: On the Origins of the Multinational Premium
title_zh: 论跨国企业溢价的起源
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the relationship between management, multinational expansion, and risk premia. We document two facts: firms run by better managers are more likely to become multinationals (MNEs), and risk premia are higher for current and future MNEs than for firms that remain exclusively domestic. We develop a model in which endogenous matching between heterogeneous firms and managers jointly determines selection into foreign direct investment (FDI) and risk premia. Quantitatively, we use the model to examine how corporate taxation and distortions in the market for managerial talent affect multinational activity, firm risk exposure, and financial market outcomes.

title: Incentives, Surrogates, and Long-run Vaccination
title_zh: 激励、替代指标与长期疫苗接种
authors: Mercade, Pol Campos, Meier, Armando N., Meier, Stephan, Pope, Devin G., Schneider, Florian H., Wengstroem, Erik
official: 官方在线 2026-06-09 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Can monetary incentives improve health behaviors in the long run, and do commonly used surrogate outcomes capture these effects? We study these questions in the context of vaccination using a large-scale eld experiment. The experiment combines commonly used surrogates|vaccination intentions, intermediate behavioral proxies, and short-run vaccination|with long-run administrative vaccination records. We first document that incentives increase vaccination rates in the long run: guaranteed $20 incentives raise COVID-19 booster uptake by 9 percentage points. Lottery-based incentives also increase long-run uptake, while prosocial incentives primarily accelerate vaccination. Second, using surrogacy methods, we study whether surrogates can predict long-run impacts. Although the surrogates are strongly correlated with eventual vaccination, the assumptions required for surrogacy methods are often violated, and they do not accurately predict long-run impacts. Our ndings highlight both the ability of incentives to change behavior and the importance of measuring long-run outcomes rather than relying solely on surrogates.
